designs.name: ASCENT Dwarf - Old Guard
designs.description: A grizzled veteran dwarf soldier in his sixties. Deep, gravelly, barrel-chested voice with a thick Scottish brogue. Gruff and commanding, barks short orders like a sergeant on a battlefield. Close-mic, dry studio recording, no reverb.

designs.name: ASCENT Dwarf - Ale Keeper
designs.description: A jolly, round-bellied dwarf tavern keeper in his fifties. Warm, booming, hearty voice with a broad Northern English accent, always on the edge of a laugh and a little tipsy. Loud and friendly, like a publican greeting his regulars. Close-mic, dry studio recording, no reverb.

designs.name: ASCENT Dwarf - Coin Counter
designs.description: A shrewd, wiry dwarf merchant and paymaster. Quick, slightly nasal, sly tenor voice with a clipped Scottish accent. Talks fast, always counting coins, delighted by a good deal and a little greedy. Close-mic, dry studio recording, no reverb.

designs.name: ASCENT Dwarf - Forewoman
designs.description: A tough, no-nonsense female dwarf mine forewoman in her forties. Strong, husky, raspy alto voice with a thick Scottish accent. Blunt, confident and energetic, used to shouting over a roaring forge. Close-mic, dry studio recording, no reverb.

designs.name: ASCENT Dwarf - Rune Elder
designs.description: An ancient dwarf rune-king. Very deep, slow, resonant bass voice with a gentle Scottish lilt. Regal and mystical, every word weighty and deliberate, like a king speaking in a vast stone hall. Close-mic, dry studio recording, no reverb.
